CustomField.description: This field is used for Walk-in Customer Requirement
CustomField.formula: IF( ClosedDate - CreatedDate > 0 , TEXT( FLOOR( ClosedDate - CreatedDate) ) & " days " & TEXT( FLOOR( MOD( (ClosedDate - CreatedDate) * 24, 24 ) ) ) & " hours " & TEXT( ROUND( MOD( (ClosedDate - CreatedDate) * 24 * 60, 60 ), 0 ) ) & " minutes", "")
CustomField.label: Total Case Completion Time
